description: This Java source file defines a class 'OrderTestServices' that provides utility methods for creating, processing, and testing sales orders within the OFBiz framework. The class includes methods for creating test sales orders, both single and multiple, handling cart operations, invoking services, and approving orders, primarily intended for testing purposes.

classes.name: OrderTestServices
classes.description: A class providing static methods for creating and managing test sales orders within the OFBiz order system.

methods.name: createTestSalesOrders
methods.description: Creates multiple test sales orders based on the specified number, invoking the creation of individual orders and logging the process.

methods.name: createTestSalesOrderSingle
methods.description: Creates a single test sales order, building a shopping cart, adding products, and processing order creation, approval, and optional shipping.
